item.title: Claude: Degraded performance for Claude Fable 5.2 (resolved)
item.description: The issue affecting claude.ai has been resolved. Impact occurred from 02:20 PT / 10:20 UTC to 02:40 PT / 10:40 UTC.

item.title: Claude: Degraded performance for Claude Fable 5.2 (triggered)
item.description: We have identified the cause of elevated errors on requests to Claude Fable 5.2 and are working on a fix. We will provide an update as soon as possible.

item.title: Claude: Claude for Microsoft 365 add-in missing for some users (triggered)
item.description: We have identified an issue with an upstream provider that is causing the Claude add-in to disappear from Excel, Word, and PowerPoint on Mac for users signed in to Microsoft Office with a personal Microsoft account. We are in contact with them. In the meantime, we recommend using the web versions of Excel, Word, and PowerPoint at office.com, where Claude remains available for many users. We will provide another update as soon as possible.
